name: UUE Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未在公告中披露各业务板块的具体扩张、缩减或合约信息，公告主要为季度业绩、股份分拆上市及公司地址变更等事项。最新一季（截至2026年8月31日）营收75,000,000令吉，净利润11,042,000令吉，同比增长71.2%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose specific expansion, reduction, or contract information for its business segments in its announcements; announcements mainly covered quarterly results, share subdivision listings, and change of address. For the latest quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was MYR 75,000,000 and net profit was MYR 11,042,000, up 71.2% year-on-year.
